title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative:
The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire and partners Borena, South Omo, Addis Ababa and Tigray works towards the goal that poor and marginalised people have sustainable livelihoods and diverse food. This objective focuses on strengthening the sustainable economic well-being of people living in poverty. Activities include support self-help groups (SHG) members on savings and credit skills, provide certified trainer-of-trainer on business to local resources and link SHG to market chains. The principal focus of this outcome is: - The sustainable economic well-being of people, especially women and youth, via market systems development initiatives - Where possible, income generating initiatives will include an agroecology lens
Capacity strengthening of communities is a core element of the approach
